description: This file provides a service layer for managing OpenAI vector stores, including retrieval, listing, creation, updating, deletion, and file management related to assistant vector stores. It interacts with OpenAI API and handles credential decryption and error handling.

methods.name: getAssistantVectorStore
methods.description: Retrieves a specific assistant vector store from OpenAI using provided credential and vector store IDs.

methods.name: listAssistantVectorStore
methods.description: Lists all assistant vector stores associated with a given credential.

methods.name: createAssistantVectorStore
methods.description: Creates a new assistant vector store in OpenAI with specified parameters.

methods.name: updateAssistantVectorStore
methods.description: Updates an existing assistant vector store with new parameters and retrieves associated files.

methods.name: deleteAssistantVectorStore
methods.description: Deletes a specified assistant vector store from OpenAI.

methods.name: uploadFilesToAssistantVectorStore
methods.description: Uploads files to an assistant vector store, converting and batching them via OpenAI API.

methods.name: deleteFilesFromAssistantVectorStore
methods.description: Deletes specified files from an assistant vector store in OpenAI.
